english_source_note: An Epsilon of Room for Measure Zero Sets
callout_id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#6
statement_en: Prove that the graph of a continuous function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, namely $$G:=\{(x,y):y=f(x)\},$$ has Lebesgue measure zero in $\mathbb{R}^2$.
key_techniques: covering the graph by thin rectangles
callout_body: 证明连续函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$的图像$$G:=\{(x,y):y=f(x)\}$$在$\mathbb{R}^2$的Lebesgue测度下是零测度的。
